          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-title",
            children: "OpenSession"
          }), _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(\n    cache cache.Cache,\n    tiers []conf.Tier,\n    configurations []conf.Configuration,\n)"
          })]
        }), " *Session {\n    ssn := openSession(cache)\n\n    ssn.Tiers = tiers\n    ssn.Configurations = configurations\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, tier := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " tiers {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, plugin := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " tier.Plugins {\n            pb, found := GetPluginBuilder(plugin.Name)\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " !found {\n                ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "continue"
        }), "\n            }\n\n            plugin := pb(plugin.Arguments)\n            ssn.plugins[plugin.Name()] = plugin\n\n            plugin.OnSessionOpen(ssn)\n        }\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ssn\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Plugin 通常会在这里做两类事情。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "一类是根据当前 Session 准备这一轮调度需要的数据。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "另一类是注册后面 Action 会调用的回调，例如："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: "ssn.AddJobOrderFn(name, fn)\nssn.AddTaskOrderFn(name, fn)\nssn.AddPredicateFn(name, fn)\nssn.AddNodeOrderFn(name, fn)\nssn.AddJobReadyFn(name, fn)\nssn.AddPreemptableFn(name, fn)\nssn.AddReclaimableFn(name, fn)\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpack"
      }), " 会注册 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NodeOrderFn"
      }), "，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "gang"
      }), " 会注册 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "JobReadyFn"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "PreemptableFn"
      }), " 等回调。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这些函数注册完成以后，Plugin 不需要主动去驱动调度流程。后面的 Action 在需要排序、过滤、打分或者检查 Job 状态时，会调用 Session 中对应的入口。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "onsessionclose",
      children: "OnSessionClose"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["所有 Action 执行结束后，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "runOnce"
      }), " 中的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "defer framework.CloseSession(ssn)"
      }), " 开始收尾："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-title",
            children: "CloseSession"
          }), _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(ssn *Session)"
          })]
        }), " {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, plugin := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " ssn.plugins {\n        plugin.OnSessionClose(ssn)\n    }\n\n    closeSession(ssn)\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["所以 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OnSessionClose"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OnSessionOpen"
      }), " 对应的是同一轮 Session 的两个生命周期阶段："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "OpenSession\n    ↓\nPlugin.OnSessionOpen\n    ↓\nAction.Execute\n    ↓\nAction.Execute\n    ↓\n...\n    ↓\nPlugin.OnSessionClose\n    ↓\ncloseSession\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OnSessionClose"
      }), " 具体做什么由 Plugin 自己决定，并不只是统一的“释放资源”。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "overcommit"
      }), " 在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OnSessionOpen"
      }), " 中会根据当前集群状态计算 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "totalResource"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "idleResource"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "inqueueResource"
      }), "，这些数据只服务当前 Session。关闭 Session 时，它会把这些字段清掉。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "gang"
      }), " 的处理更明显。它会在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OnSessionClose"
      }), " 中查看这一轮调度结束后的 Job 状态。如果 Gang 仍然没有达到 Ready 条件，会更新对应的 PodGroup Condition 和调度指标；已经 Ready 的 Job 则记录 Scheduled 状态。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此 Plugin 的生命周期覆盖了整轮调度："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "OnSessionOpen"
        }), " 看到的是这一轮开始时的 Session，可以准备状态并注册规则；"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "中间的 Action 使用这些规则进行调度；"
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "OnSessionClose"
        }), " 看到的是 Action 执行后的结果，可以根据最终状态做更新或清理。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["framework 自己的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "closeSession"
      }), " 随后还会更新 Job、Queue 等状态，并释放这一轮 Session 持有的数据。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "session-如何使用-plugin-注册的规则",
      children: "Session 如何使用 Plugin 注册的规则"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["以 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 这个 Action 为例，Queue、Job、Task 的排序，以及节点过滤、节点打分和 Job Ready 判断，都会调用 Session 中已经注册好的回调。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 本身不需要针对 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "priority"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "gang"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpack"
      }), " 分别写一套处理逻辑。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["例如 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpack"
      }), " 在 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "OnSessionOpen"
      }), " 中注册节点打分函数："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: "ssn.AddNodeOrderFn(bp.Name(), nodeOrderFn)\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["后面 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 选择节点时调用的是："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: "ssn.NodeOrderFn(task, node)\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Session 再找到当前启用 Plugin 注册的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "NodeOrderFn"
      }), " 并计算结果。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["节点过滤也是类似的关系。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 进入 Predicate 阶段后，通过 Session 调用已经注册的节点过滤函数，而不是直接调用某个 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "predicatesPlugin"
      }), " 对象的方法。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "一次调度周期中的主要关系可以画成："
    }), "\n", _jsx(Mermaid, {
      chart: "flowchart LR\n    C[Scheduler 配置] --> A[actions]\n    C --> T[tiers / plugins]\n\n    T --> O[OpenSession]\n    O --> P[Plugin OnSessionOpen]\n    P --> S[Session 回调]\n\n    A --> R[runOnce]\n    R --> E[Action Execute]\n\n    S --> E\n\n    E --> Q[Queue / Job / Task Order]\n    E --> F[Predicate]\n    E --> N[NodeOrder]\n    E --> G[Job Ready / Pipelined]\n    E --> B[Statement Commit / Discard]\n\n    E --> X[全部 Action 结束]\n    X --> PC[Plugin OnSessionClose]\n    PC --> CS[closeSession]\n"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "不过，只知道“Plugin 把函数注册到 Session”还不够。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["多个 Plugin 可以注册同一种回调。例如 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-keyword",

          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"

          className: "hljs-keyword",

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-number",

          className: "hljs-keyword",

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " err := pfn(task, node); err != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n                ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " err\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), "\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "只要当前节点还没有失败，就会继续执行后面的 Predicate。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "任意一个 Plugin 返回错误，节点立即被过滤。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "所以 Predicate 中虽然仍然按照 tier 顺序遍历，但 tier 并不表示“第一层检查通过以后就不用执行第二层”。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "nodeorder分数直接累加",
      children: "NodeOrder：分数直接累加"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {

            className: "hljs-keyword",

          className: "hljs-type",

          children: "error"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "continue"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"

          className: "hljs-literal",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "nodeorder"
      }), "、", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpack"
      }), " 等 Plugin 都可以贡献自己的分数，Session 把结果加在一起。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这种情况下，Plugin 位于哪个 tier 并不会让前一个 tier 的 NodeOrder 独占决定权。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "jobready任何一个失败都不能-ready",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "JobReady"
      }), " 会遍历所有启用的规则："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这里的 tier 同样主要影响遍历顺序，而不是形成 fallback。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "投票类回调当前-tier-可以直接形成决定",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "true"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",

      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "而："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "Tier 1\n  Plugin A -> Abstain\n  Plugin B -> Abstain\n\n没有形成决定\n    ↓\n继续检查 Tier 2\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这里 tier 的“组”就真正影响了最终控制流。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h2, {
      id: "tier-最典型的场景抢占和资源回收",
      children: "tier 最典型的场景：抢占和资源回收"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "如果只看 Predicate 和 NodeOrder，很容易觉得："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.blockquote, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "既然 Plugin 最后都要执行，为什么还要多套一层 tier？"
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这个疑问在 eviction 场景下最容易解释。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Preemptable"
      }), " 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Reclaimable"

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["以 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Preemptable"
      }), " 的主要逻辑为例："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",

            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(ssn *Session)"

        }), " Preemptable(\n    preemptor *api.TaskInfo,\n    preemptees []*api.TaskInfo,\n) []*api.TaskInfo {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "var"
        }), " victims []*api.TaskInfo\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, tier := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " ssn.Tiers {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "for"
        }), " _, plugin := ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "range"
        }), " tier.Plugins {\n            pf, found := ssn.preemptableFns[plugin.Name]\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " !found {\n                ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "continue"
        }), "\n            }\n\n            candidates, abstain := pf(preemptor, preemptees)\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " abstain == ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), " {\n                ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "continue"
        }), "\n            }\n\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-built_in",
          children: "len"
        }), "(candidates) == ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-number",
          children: "0"
        }), " {\n                victims = ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), "\n                ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",

          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"

          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n                victims = candidates\n            } ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "else"
        }), " {\n                victims = intersection(victims, candidates)\n            }\n        }\n\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " victims != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " {\n            ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " victims\n        }\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "return"
        }), " victims\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "同一个 tier 中，如果多个 Plugin 都给出了 victim 集合，Session 会不断取交集。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "例如最初有："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Plugin A 认为："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "{pod-a, pod-b, pod-c}\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "可以驱逐。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "{pod-b, pod-c}\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "可以驱逐。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这一层最终留下："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "{pod-b, pod-c}\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "也就是这一组规则共同允许驱逐的 Task。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "如果当前 tier 已经得到了有效 victim，Session 直接返回，不再尝试下一 tier。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "只有这一 tier 没有形成可用的 victim 结果时，才继续尝试下一组 Plugin。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这就允许配置表达类似这样的策略："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "Tier 1\n    先使用一组影响较小、限制更严格的 victim 规则\n            ↓\n    能找到 victim\n            ↓\n          直接使用\n\n    找不到\n            ↓\n\nTier 2\n    再尝试另一组 eviction 规则\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此不能简单把 tier 理解成："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.blockquote, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.blockquote, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

          children: "tier"
        }), " 给多个 Plugin 划出有顺序的组，Session 的具体扩展点再决定这些组如何参与最终判断。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "对于排序，它表现为前面的规则更早获得决定权；对于 Predicate 和 JobReady，仍然需要所有相关规则通过；对于 NodeOrder，多个 Plugin 的分数会累加；而在抢占、回收和部分投票类接口中，一个 tier 可以先形成决定，从而不再进入下一 tier。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h2, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

      })
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["两个节点都通过 Predicate 时，", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpack"
      }), " 会更偏向 Node A。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["如果 Node A 因为 taint、设备资源或其他条件没有通过 Predicate，它在进入 NodeOrder 之前就已经被过滤。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "binpack"
      }), " 只负责贡献节点分数，不会把一个 Predicate 已经拒绝的节点重新放回来。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Gang 条件则影响后面的提交。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["假设 Job 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "MinAvailable"
      }), " 是 4，本轮只有 3 个 Task 找到了节点。", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocate"
      }), " 可以先在 Session 中试算这些结果，但 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "JobReady"
      }), " 返回 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "false"
      }), " 时，这一组分配不能直接 Commit。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "后续调度周期还可以重新尝试。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h2, {
      id: "preempt-中的-action-和-plugin",
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "preempt"
      }), " 中的 Action 和 Plugin"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "preempt"
      }), " 使用的还是同一套关系。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Action 负责扫描 starving Job、构造候选集、修改 Statement，并决定最终 Commit 还是 Discard："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-go",
        children: [_jsxs(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-function",
          children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-keyword",
            children: "func"
          }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
            className: "hljs-params",
            children: "(pmpt *Action)"
          })]
        }), " Execute(ssn *framework.Session) {\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " !ssn.JobStarving(preemptorJob) {\n        ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "continue"
        }), "\n    }\n\n    victims := ssn.Preemptable(preemptor, preemptees)\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ... 将合法 victim 写入 Statement"
        }), "\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "if"
        }), " ssn.JobPipelined(preemptorJob) {\n        stmt.Commit()\n    } ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-keyword",
          children: "else"
        }), " {\n        stmt.Discard()\n    }\n\n    ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-comment",
          children: "// ..."
        }), "\n}\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "具体哪些 Task 可以成为 victim，则由 Plugin 注册的回调判断。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "例如："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "priority"
        }), " 限制 victim 的优先级；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "gang"
        }), " 避免驱逐后破坏另一个 Job 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "MinAvailable"
        }), "；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "conformance"
        }), " 排除不能由普通抢占驱逐的关键 Pod。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "假设一开始的候选集是："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsx(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-text",
        children: "{low-1, low-2, critical}\n"
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "不同 Plugin 可以分别过滤这批候选对象。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["如果它们位于同一个 tier，并且都参与 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Preemptable"
      }), "，最终得到的是这些规则共同接受的 victim。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "如果这个 tier 已经形成有效结果，Session 就不会再尝试后面的 eviction tier。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Action 拿到最终 victim 后继续进行驱逐试算。如果释放这些资源后仍然不能让 preemptor 进入 Pipelined 状态，Statement 会被 Discard，本轮试算随之回滚。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.h2, {
      id: "actionsplugin-和-tiers-的区别",
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "actions"
      }), "、Plugin 和 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "tiers"
      }), " 的区别"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "回到最开始的配置，这三个概念解决的是三个不同的问题。"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-yaml",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "actions:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "\"enqueue, allocate, backfill\""
        }), "\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "决定的是："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.blockquote, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "这一轮调度要执行哪些过程？"
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "而："
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {
        className: "hljs language-yaml",
        children: [_jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-bullet",
          children: "-"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "name:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "predicates"
        }), "\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-bullet",
          children: "-"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "name:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "binpack"
        }), "\n", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-bullet",
          children: "-"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-attr",
          children: "name:"
        }), " ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-string",
          children: "gang"
        }), "\n"]
      })
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "这些 Plugin 决定的是："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.blockquote, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "Action 执行这些过程时，具体采用哪些排序、过滤、打分或状态判断规则？"
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "tier"
      }), " 再解决："]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.blockquote, {
      children: ["\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
        children: "多个 Plugin 同时参与同一种判断时，它们按照什么分组和顺序组合？"
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "因此："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["删除 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "backfill"
        }), "，意味着不再执行这个 Action；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["加入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "binpack"
        }), "，意味着多了一种节点打分规则，并不会多出一个调度阶段；"]
      }), "\n", _jsx(_components.li, {
        children: "把 Plugin 放到不同 tier，不是给不同 Action 分配 Plugin；"
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["所有 Action 使用的是同一轮 Session，调用某个 Session 入口时，Session 再按照这个入口自己的规则遍历 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "tiers"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "阅读 Volcano Scheduler 这部分源码时，Action、Plugin 和 Session 通常需要放在一起看。"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Action 决定调度器当前在做什么，以及流程推进到哪里；Plugin 在 Session 打开时注册具体规则，也可以在 Session 关闭时根据这一轮结果做收尾；Session 保存本轮调度的数据和回调，并负责在 Action 调用这些入口时按照 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "tiers"
      }), " 和对应扩展点的语义组合多个 Plugin 的结果。"]
    })]
  });
}
function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
